criteria.description: One content-height centered section/copy/h1/description/form/email/submit/legal/terms/status; zero media/dialog/nav/logo/extra CTA/form
Form stacks through 639px and becomes growing-email/intrinsic-submit row at 640px
Copy and form remain finite, centered, aligned and overflow-free from 320 through 1280
Visible label, native required/email rules, one hidden-then-visible error, live success, focus, 44px and axe AA
Real native form action and terms destination work without JavaScript; enhanced success never duplicates validation
Light/dark contrast and reduced-motion transition collapse remain coherent
Vanilla Light DOM, documented Ren10 primitives/tokens and one root-scoped module only
